description: Use this when you need a page's main text as Markdown for an LLM or RAG pipeline (for metadata, links and word count in the same call, see web_read). Fetch a public HTML page and convert main/article content to Markdown (Turndown). Scripts/styles stripped; output capped. Good for RAG/agent ingestion. Returns JSON with: title, markdown, chars. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/url-markdown
name: url_markdown
title: Url Markdown
